subject: combining multiple plot types with facet_plot()

messages.author: a1832b5763285727
messages.subject: combining multiple plot types with facet_plot()
parts:
I am interested in plotting a box_ploth() with the included points (hopefully using jitter).

I have figured out how to combine a box_plot() and geom_point() using geom_fruit() and geom_fruit_list() (but I do not know how to jitter the points or use a log10 scale), so I am hoping that facet_plot() may give more flexibility.

But I do not see a way to put two different plot types in the same facet_plot() facet.  Is there an equivalent to geom_fruit_list() for facet_plot()?

And it is unclear to me where I would put scale_x_log10() if I wanted to have a custom scale for that facet.

Appreciate advice.

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: combining multiple plot types with facet_plot()
parts:
You are welcome to propose feature requests on github for these features.
Currently, you can do it manually. For example, you can use the jitter() function to add noise to points.

try the following code to see the difference.

ggplot(mtcars) + geom_point(aes(mpg, cyl))
ggplot(mtcars) + geom_point(aes(mpg, jitter(cyl)))

messages.subject: Re: combining multiple plot types with facet_plot()
parts:
As far as I can tell, it is not possible to jitter points in a geom_fruit(), because the mapping function given to geom_fruit() expects a string, not a function.  If I try this:
   fruit2 <-  geom_fruit(
              data=all_data,
              geom = geom_point, mapping=aes(y=mtGenome_acc, x=h_cnt, color=g_type,shape=g_type),
              size=2.0,alpha=0.5,
              offset=0.4,   # The distance between layers, default is 0.03 of x range of tree.
              pwidth=4.0, # width of the layer, default is 0.2 of x range of tree.
          )
it works (but no jitter).

If I try this:
  fruit2 <-  geom_fruit(
              data=all_data,
              geom = geom_point, mapping=aes(y=mtGenome_acc, x=jitter(h_cnt), color=g_type,shape=g_type),
              size=2.0,alpha=0.5,
              offset=0.4,   # The distance between layers, default is 0.03 of x range of tree.
              pwidth=4.0, # width of the layer, default is 0.2 of x range of tree.
          )

I get the error message:    Error: Can't convert a call to a string

messages.author: 48f5ec8bf2672921
messages.subject: Re: combining multiple plot types with facet_plot()
parts:
The newest ggtreeExtra has supported it, we built a new position method— position_jitterx.
It should work by adding position=position_jitterx() in your fruit2. you can use remotes::install_github("YuLab-SMU/ggtreeExtra") to update it.
Then you can run example(position_jitterx) to see the example of position_jitterx.

​
